The '''Tyan sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in<ref name="Mid Rim" /> the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="New Territories" /> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it bordered the [[Droma sector/Legends|Droma sector]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]], the [[Qiilura sector/Legends|Qiilura sector]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]], the [[Irishi sector/Legends|Irishi]] and [[Corthenia sector/Legends|Corthenia sectors]] [[spinward]], and the [[Kesh sector/Legends|Kesh]] and [[Alderath sector/Legends|Alderath sectors]] in the [[trailing]] direction.<ref name="Mid Rim" />

The Tyan sector contained the [[Osskorn system/Legends|Osskorn system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> the origin point of the [[Osskorn Stout]] beverage;<ref name="DoG">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Delusions of Grandeur]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Osskorn Stout]]|system=Osskorn [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> and the [[Vvan system]], which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tyan]] that was represented in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Galim Eddawan]] by around<ref name="LotJ">''[[Legacy of the Jedi]]''</ref> [[76 BBY/Legends|76 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the section of ''[[Legacy of the Jedi]]'' in which [[Tyan]] is mentioned to [[76 BBY/Legends|76 BBY]].</ref> The [[Entralla Route/Legends|Entralla Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] ran through the Vvan [[Star system/Legends|system]] and connected it to the Irishi and Qiilura sectors, while another [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route passed through both the Osskorn and Vvan systems and linked the Tyan sector to the Alderath and Corthenia sectors.<ref name="EGTW" />

By [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the Tyan sector was a part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] prevailed over the New Republic in a [[Battle of Tyan|confrontation]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] at Tyan.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tyan sector was first mentioned in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EAOC" /> The StarWars.com article "[https://web.archive.org/web/20170713024921/https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim]" later provided the first visual depiction of the sector.<ref name="Mid Rim" />
